paper.title: Noisy Blackbox Optimization with Multi-Fidelity Queries: A Tree Search Approach

settings.name_in_paper: Multi-fidelity noisy black-box optimization with hierarchical partitions (simple regret under cost budget)
unmapped: Multi-fidelity queries: each query (x,z) with fidelity z in [0,1] returns f_z(x)+noise with bias |f_z(x)-f(x)| <= zeta(z) and costs lambda(z) >= 1; highest fidelity z=1 is unbiased
The learner knows the bias function zeta and the cost function lambda
Total cost budget Lambda instead of a horizon; number of queries N(Lambda) is random
Learner is given a hierarchical (binary tree) partition of the domain with representative points

Smoothness: Assumption 1 jointly on f and the partition with parameters (nu, rho), near-optimality dimension d(nu,rho) with constant C(nu,rho); MFHOO knows (nu, rho), MFPOO only upper bounds (nu_max, rho_max)
Simple regret measured at the highest fidelity
settings.definition_quote: An evaluation of a function consists of two inputs $(x,z)$ corresponding to the query point $x \in \mathcal{X}$ and fidelity $z \in \mathcal{Z},$ and results in a random variable $Y$ as the output, with $Y = f_z(x) + \epsilon.$ Here, $\epsilon$ is a sub-Gaussian noise random variable ... A query at $(x, z)$ results in an output mean with $\lvert f_z(x) - f(x) \rvert \leq \zeta(z)$ and at cost $\lambda(z).$ ... the \textit{simple regret} is given by $S(\Lambda) = f^* - \EE[f(\hat{X}_{\Lambda})]$.

settings.name_in_paper: Multi-fidelity noisy black-box optimization with hierarchical partitions (cumulative regret over n queries)
unmapped: Multi-fidelity queries with bias bounded by known zeta(z); cumulative regret measured on f (highest fidelity) at the queried points
The learner knows the bias function zeta
Learner is given a hierarchical partition; smoothness Assumption 1 with known (nu, rho); near-optimality dimension d(nu,rho)
settings.definition_quote: Given that a policy performs $n$ evaluations or queries, the cumulative regret is given by $R_n = \EE \left[ \sum_{t = 1}^{n} [f^* - f(X_t)]\right].$

symbols.C_nr: constant C(nu,rho) in the near-optimality dimension definition
symbols.n_Lambda: n(Lambda) = max{n : sum_{h=1}^n lambda(z_h) <= Lambda}, with z_h = zeta^{-1}(nu rho^h)

tuning: queries at height h made at fidelity z_h with zeta(z_h) = nu rho^h
